pain_paragraph: Agencies and dev shops often finish the work, send the invoice, then get dragged into a second round of explanation before finance or the client lead will approve it. The real cost is slower cash collection, founders rewriting summaries at night, project managers digging through Slack, and avoidable scope disputes.

Account leads scramble to prove what was actually delivered

Clients ask for screenshots, links, and status history after the fact
after: Every invoice includes a clean proof-of-work pack
Completed work, evidence links, and pending items are easy to review

pricing_details: Includes up to 4 invoice proof packs per month for one client account and one supported project system. Growth tier: $1,250-$1,500/month for multi-project or higher-touch accounts. Pilot offer: one invoice cycle proof pack for $300, credited toward month one.
guarantee_line: If we miss the agreed 24-hour turnaround on a standard pack, that cycle is free.

faq.q: How do you access our work artifacts safely?
faq.a: Least-privilege access only. Usually that means a shared folder plus read-only access to one project system or exported reports. No production credentials required, and NDA is fine.

faq.q: What needs to be true for this to work well?
faq.a: You need one supported source of truth for project activity, like Linear, Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, or a clean weekly update doc. If work evidence is spread across random chats with no owner, we will ask you to tighten the input first.

We define the client-facing pack format, billing cadence, included sections, evidence sources, and approval owner. Most onboarding can be done in under an hour if your project artifacts are reasonably organized.

faq.q: How long do you retain our materials?
faq.a: Only as long as needed for active work and template improvement. Default retention is 30 days for exported working files unless you request a shorter or longer window.

trust_basics_line: Not a fit if you want us to chase payment, rewrite the contract, or invent proof that does not exist. Best fit is teams with real work evidence but messy invoice communication.
